name: Philadelphia South / Clarksboro KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 117 Timberlane Rd, Clarksboro; full-hookup RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $75-115 a night before tax for a mid-May 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4.5*, $$$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/philadelphia-south/reserve/) quoted 2027-05-18, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: RV site types $75-115 before tax (read 2026-10-19); RV Life 4.5* over 476 reviews, 104 sites; within 40 km of a gateway (Philadelphia (17 km), gateways.py), so the price gate is lifted
wf: KOA's booking form names a 'Semi-Wooded, Pond View' type; re-audited: satellite (Esri, sat.py) read 2026-10-19: semi-wooded loops off Mill Rd around a ~60 m pond ringed by trees; no pad confirmed with an open view of it; not waterfront
